items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: the title Evidence was (a) the title of a Monk tune

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m going to be joined by Christian Goodwillie who is the Director of Special Collections at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Jerry Gordon with us today. And I’m going to introduce you as a man who channeled his early obsession for music into a number of very productive projects and is valuable for musicians and listeners. How is that for a mouthful?
Well thank you, Monk, you made me presentable, I really appreciate that.
I think you and I have a number of things in common and one of them would have been staying up late listening to a transistor radio.
